name: esp-32-toki-pona
description: Toki Pona <-> five-language dictionary for ESP32, with sitelen pona glyphs.

scripts.test:host: python3 tools/fb_capture.py --selftest && node tools/check-notices.mjs && node tools/check-font-coverage.mjs && node tools/generate.mjs && mkdir -p build && g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -I core test/test_search.cpp core/normalize.cpp core/search.cpp core/dictionary_gen.cpp -o build/test_search && ./build/test_search && g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -I core -I hal test/test_input_event.cpp -o build/test_input_event && ./build/test_input_event && g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -I core -I hal test/test_cardputer_keymap.cpp hal/input/cardputer_keymap.cpp -o build/test_cardputer_keymap && ./build/test_cardputer_keymap && g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -I core test/test_sitelen.cpp core/sitelen.cpp core/sitelen_gen.cpp core/dictionary_gen.cpp -o build/test_sitelen && ./build/test_sitelen && g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -I core test/test_cjk.cpp core/cjk.cpp core/cjk_gen.cpp -o build/test_cjk && ./build/test_cjk && g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -I core -I hal -I app test/test_ui.cpp app/ui_controller.cpp app/render.cpp core/normalize.cpp core/search.cpp core/sitelen.cpp core/sitelen_gen.cpp core/logo_gen.cpp core/cjk.cpp core/cjk_gen.cpp core/dictionary_gen.cpp -o build/test_ui && ./build/test_ui
